title: Professional ethics case analysis with an LLM discussion partner
summary: Groups analyze a fictional professional ethics dilemma in class and then with an LLM of their choice. They submit a report documenting both discussions, prompts and outputs, evaluate the LLM's analysis and writing, and choose their own ethical action.

sources.title: Student Perspectives on Using a Large Language Model (LLM) for an Assignment on Professional Ethics
sources.evidence_quote: make use of an LLM of their choice as a discussion partner

course.name: Professional competencies for computing master's programs

context.learner_level: computer science and embedded systems master's students

assessment.summary: Analyze whether a fictional researcher should attend CHI 2024 in Hawaii using an ethical-process framework.
student_actions: Discuss the case in class and take notes.
Analyze the case with an LLM using assigned ethical theories.
Critique the analysis and writing and select a course of action.

outputs.artifact: Group report with discussion notes, prompts, AI output, citations, and reflection

student_role.description: An LLM was required as a discussion partner; all groups used ChatGPT and had to report and critique its output.

grading.method: Pass/fail with feedback and resubmission; every course assignment had to pass.

provenance.extraction_method: Full PDF read from pdftotext output.

reported_results: Twelve consenting reports from 16 four-person groups were thematically analyzed.

evidence_excerpts.quote: make use of an LLM of their choice as a discussion partner
